decisions.reason: Locates the upper-only/lower-only branches in renderer-excerpt.ts, explains that fg-only SGR leaves the previous cell's background active so the empty half of a right-edge half-filled cell is painted with stale color, ties it to the outline/sleep-Z/heart edge symptoms, and prescribes ESC[49m/39m or RESET+fg per cell rather than a row-end-only reset.

Identifies the renderer's trailing-space trim (out.replace(/[ ]+$/)) plus the pipeline stripping trailing whitespace so a narrower frame never overwrites the previous wide frame's surplus columns; proposes full-width row output combined with erase-to-EOL (ESC[K) while keeping SGR state explicit, not mere padding.

Uses frames-digest-report.txt: tail2 MISMATCH with 23 differing cells from hand-copying, notes the visible shifted cluster is the diff but the count is 23, distinguishes port drift from renderer artifacts, explains a different-frame excerpt regression missed it, and gates with per-frame sha256 comparison against trusted source art in CI.

Correctly uses ci-hang-evidence.txt: mounted probe hosts finish without unmounting while the planner continuously re-arms setTimeout handles, finished checks cannot exit, and the interactive terminal is already kept alive by TTY/stdin. However the prescribed fix is teardown/clearTimeout on unmount; the rubric's unref-per-newly-scheduled-timeout fix appears only as a parenthetical alternative and the pending-timer-only unref it describes would not cover the rescheduling chain.

Checklist consolidates explicit both-dimension SGR reset, full-width/erase-to-EOL rows with balanced SGR state, and source-art digest pinning of every frame; the pre-rollout audit covers event-loop drain/liveness regression, unmount coverage of every mounting host (especially probes), buffer snapshots, and digest gate before default-on.

caps.reason: Final advice affirms resetting the half-cell background, replacing trim with full-width/erase clearing, source-backed all-frame digest checks, and timer lifecycle ownership; unref is acknowledged as unpinning CI rather than called harmful, and no terminal-emulator blame replaces the renderer fixes.
